head: ca34e55620e54a94146a5509277ac7df6d4ba2ae
instrument: bug-hunt round 6 edit audit (wf_2ea672d2-607); prior latest.json archived as r6-previous-latest.json

findings.title: StochasticOU checkpoint read now hard-requires a `seed` HDF5 attribute that older checkpoint files do not have, with no fallback and no schema bump
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: StochasticOU's new `seed` struct field is missing from the type's own `# Fields` docstring section
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): the seed bullet added to StochasticOU's # Fields inventory.

findings.title: Routing VarianceController's empty-band warning through ConstantPower's shared `_injection_amplitude` merges two previously-independent `maxlog=1` diagnostic budgets into one
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): _injection_amplitude takes the calling strategy as a Symbol, names it in the message, and keys the dedup budget per strategy via _id.

findings.title: Every StochasticOU checkpoint written before this window is now unreadable, failing with a raw KeyError
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: The empty-band warning lost its strategy attribution and now prints different numbers
findings.disposition: fixed in part (attribution restored via the strategy Symbol); the factor-scaled quoted numbers stay — the emptiness test is factor-invariant and the quoted pair self-consistent.

findings.title: fields_modified!'s new restart! dispatch is a verified no-op justified only by twin-symmetry
findings.disposition: refused: the dismissals audit independently adjudicated this three-way disagreement and ruled the dispatch correct; the rationale is recorded at the particles twin.

findings.title: Forcing constructors now silently truncate an explicitly higher-precision scalar to the domain's type
findings.disposition: accepted as intended: the domain's element type is the strategies' contract — the witnessed genericity invariant.

findings.title: The new scalar_diffusivity(conditions) docstring can never render, and the name now exists twice
findings.disposition: accepted: an unexported helper's docstring serves the ?REPL reader; the cross-module name parallel is deliberate, with no dispatch clash.

findings.title: Empty-band warn collapsed to one anonymous site: the second inert forcing is now silent, and no warning names its strategy
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): _injection_amplitude takes the calling strategy as a Symbol, names it in the message, and keys the dedup budget per strategy via _id.

findings.title: Validity guards now certify a value other than the one stored: the Float32 narrowing runs after the finiteness/positivity checks
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): every forcing constructor casts to the domain's element type BEFORE its guards, so the checks certify the stored values.

findings.title: Float32 runs now compute forcing in Float32 — every default-forced Float32 run's numbers change
findings.disposition: accepted as intended: the stated genericity invariant, witnessed by r6-numerics-and-types-01.

findings.title: read_forcing(StochasticOU) now requires a seed attribute — checkpoints written before this commit fail to read
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: AdamsBashforth allocate_buffers now refuses an over-deep cache history at construction
findings.disposition: accepted as intended: the allocator enforces the equality every advect! demands — the witnessed fix.

findings.title: The empty-band warning is consolidated: one shared site, renamed text, factor-scaled numbers
findings.disposition: fixed in part (attribution restored via the strategy Symbol); the factor-scaled quoted numbers stay — the emptiness test is factor-invariant and the quoted pair self-consistent.

findings.title: read_forcing(StochasticOU) now rejects every checkpoint file written before this commit
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: Int(seed) narrows the accepted seed domain: UInt64/BigInt seeds valid at base now throw InexactError
findings.disposition: accepted with reasoning: the persistence layer needs a fixed-width seed; an out-of-range UInt64/BigInt now throws InexactError at construction — a loud refusal on an archived, un-exported strategy, not silent corruption.

findings.title: Domain-eltype demotion applied to ALL five forcing constructors — wider than the witnessed default-path defect, and the new test pins the new contract
findings.disposition: accepted as deliberate class fix (the instrument's own rule); the guard-order repair closed the certification gap the widening opened.

findings.title: allocate_buffers(AdamsBashforth) tightened >= to ==: newly rejects an over-deep cache at allocation
findings.disposition: accepted as intended: the allocator enforces the equality every advect! demands — the witnessed fix.

findings.title: The controller's empty-band warning changed voice and quoted values in the dedup
findings.disposition: fixed in part (attribution restored via the strategy Symbol); the factor-scaled quoted numbers stay — the emptiness test is factor-invariant and the quoted pair self-consistent.

findings.title: StochasticOU HDF5 checkpoints: seed made required-on-read with no version bump or fallback, breaking pre-existing files
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: StochasticOU gains a field mid-struct (breaking positional-constructor arity/order) with no matching docstring update
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): the # Fields inventory updated; the positional form is internal-only (the keyword constructor is the documented surface).

findings.title: AdamsBashforth's allocate_buffers narrowed from >= to == — checked, not a genuine regression
findings.disposition: accepted as intended: the allocator enforces the equality every advect! demands — the witnessed fix.

findings.title: Domain-element-type cast on forcing `target` silently breaks the derived-viscosity mismatch guard on Float32 domains
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): the mismatch tolerance is max(1e-8, 100·eps(one(vf.target))), absorbing Float32 storage precision.

findings.title: Finite/positive guards on target/gain/turnover_time run before the domain-precision cast, so a validated value can silently become Inf after construction
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): every forcing constructor casts to the domain's element type BEFORE its guards, so the checks certify the stored values.

findings.title: StochasticOU checkpoint fix silently breaks reading of pre-fix files, undisclosed by the claim
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): read_forcing falls back to seed = 0 via haskey when the attribute is absent, restoring pre-fix files to exactly their base behaviour; no schema bump needed since old files stay readable.

findings.title: StochasticOU's own # Fields docstring was not updated for the new seed field it now carries
findings.disposition: fixed (ca34e55): the seed bullet added to StochasticOU's # Fields inventory.

findings.title: VarianceController's empty-band dedup silently changes the warning text a user sees, beyond the claimed comment-truthing
findings.disposition: fixed in part (attribution restored via the strategy Symbol); the factor-scaled quoted numbers stay — the emptiness test is factor-invariant and the quoted pair self-consistent.
